Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: Electoral lists managed by ANIE, biometric ID used for verification, digital processes proposed but manual voter cards mentioned; partially deployed.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Changed. The original IPU Parline source describes parliamentary structure and is unrelated to the electoral register. International IDEA's ICTs in Elections database confirms ANIE maintains a continuous, electronically updated voter register, and April 2026 state-media reporting confirms a live nationwide online portal (services.ina-elections.dz) for registration/removal/updates across all 1,541 municipalities ahead of the July 2026 legislative election — this supports Fully deployed nationwide (5) rather than Partially deployed.

Definition: Is the register integrated with the national ID system?
Comments: Biometric national ID used for voter verification at polling stations.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Changed. The cited source is an academic proposal for a new blockchain/NFC voting system, not evidence of current integration; it explicitly states the biometric national ID card 'has remained unexploited and underutilised' for voting. International IDEA's ICTs in Elections database confirms no electronic poll books are used and records no data on biometric capture/use in registration, so the evidence supports No integration (1), not Partially integrated (4).

Definition: What proportion of the electorate does the register cover?
Comments: Over 24 million voters registered for presidential election.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Changed. The cited figure is stale (2019) and used an unclear denominator. International IDEA's Voter Turnout Database and IFES/Electionguide.org report 24,351,551 registered voters against a voting-age population of 30,243,035 for the September 2024 presidential election (80.5%), which falls in the 70-89% band (4), not >89%. An April 2026 revision put registration above 24.5 million, consistent with this band given continued population growth.

Definition: Does the government maintain a separate cadastral register?
Comments: National Cadastre computerized cadastral mapping system since 1993.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Changed. The original source is a private consultancy's dated (c.2003) self-promotional project page and gets the establishment year wrong: the Agence Nationale du Cadastre (ANC) was created by Décret exécutif n°89-234 of 1989, distinct from the land-title register. Fresh 2026 reporting confirms the cadastre is digitised via the FADAELDJAZAIR online portal (CC11/CC12 extracts) but delimitation work is not yet complete nationwide (75% urban, 98% rural coverage at end-2025) — this supports Partially deployed nationwide (4) rather than Fully deployed.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital land register?
Comments: AMLAK electronic land system rolled out nationwide, replaces paper titles with electronic, connects all land registry offices.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Changed. The Ecofin Agency article itself describes a rollout that 'has begun' rather than one that is complete, and a follow-up decree (published 27 January 2026) only just formalised the electronic land booklet, describing a 'progressive replacement' of paper titles still to come. This is best classed as Partially deployed nationwide (4), not Fully deployed, until the AMLAK connection of all registry offices is confirmed complete.

revision_notes: Confirmed. Coverage remains programme/contributory-scheme specific rather than a single unified social registry, consistent with Partially deployed (4).
